target_questions.question: Does the multiscale two-fluid method add independent physical evidence beyond existing interface-resolved SIE studies?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 C007/C025 already represent the multiscale cascade and interface-resolved breakup; this paper is checked for incremental late-stage value.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The multiscale two-fluid framework represents all SIE breakup stages and the late dense mist across three incident-shock Mach numbers at lower cost than fully interface-resolved treatment.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: A sharp interface for the parent structure is coupled to subgrid treatment of dispersed fragments.

limitations: Primarily a computational-method contribution and substantially overlaps existing SIE mechanism evidence.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
